newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse sees turnover, prices sink.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse sees turnover, prices sink.

text.p: Most Bucharest bourse prices sagged on Thursday when turnover plunged to 20.5 million lei, or less than half the previous level, in what traders said was almost complete absence of buying interest.
The day's poor bourse performance sent two independent indexes to year lows.
"Activity was sluggish as investors seem to be getting ready for the opening of the OTC market," said one trader.

Romania inaugurated the RASDAQ, an over-the-counter trading system based on the U.S. NASDAQ exchange, at the end of September. It has since been through tests and is expected to go into actual trading on Friday.
RASDAQ officials said a decision on the start of OTC trading was to be reached later in the day.
Thursday's bourse turnover was the lowest since July and seven of the 13 traded stocks closed lower. Shares of only two companies picked up, while two stocks remained flat and two had no trade.
Fertiliser maker Azomures SA took half of the overall turnover, but it shed 100 lei, closing at 10,000.

Two unofficial value-weighted indexes -- the VAB, computed by Vanguard SA securities, and the BIG of Bucharest Investment Group -- fell to year lows. The VAB dropped by 1.7 percent from the previous session to 287.3 points and the BIG dropped by 1.55 percent to 286.16 points.
